30.evidenceText: 4 product listings examined (red, copper, gold CoreCap variants and black AL Valve). None of the provided content snippets contain stock status information such as 'out of stock', 'currently unavailable', 'nicht verfügbar', or 'ausverkauft'.
30.extractionRationale: Stock status indicators cannot be determined from the provided evidence. While 4 product listings are available, the text content provided does not include stock availability statements. To accurately determine the percentage of out-of-stock listings, the full product page content including inventory/availability sections would be needed.

62.evidenceText: The page shows "1,793.99" as a price value but does not clearly state this as the US Midwest aluminum premium in USD per pound. The displayed value appears to be a futures index or benchmark price rather than a premium quote.
62.extractionRationale: While the source page is titled "Aluminium Premium Duty paid US Midwest," the numerical value shown (1,793.99) is not explicitly identified as a premium in USD/lb. This value appears to be a futures price index that cannot be directly converted to the requested premium metric without additional context.
